findings: Datapod Pty Ltd signed a six-year global supply agreement worth up to $2.3 billion with Oracle in April 2026, which includes a forecast revenue of $100 million over the following 12 months to provide, install, and service modular AI data centers for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

The company was awarded a $12 million contract extension by the Australian Department of Defence in April 2022 to manufacture 120 modular data center units, expanding upon an initial $20 million contract finalized in August 2020.

We verified that the company exhibits strong financial health and commercial viability through multi-million and multi-billion dollar contracts with national defense agencies and international cloud hyperscalers.
